title: Étale hypercovers over algebraic spaces and scheme base change
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $T$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. On the big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site], define the functor $B_X: (Sch/T)\to Sh((Sch/T)_{fppf})/X$ by $V\mapsto (X\times h_V\to X)$, the product of sheaves with first projection, and $f\mapsto id_X\times h_f$; this is $X\times_T V$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For a simplicial object $U$ of this slice [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], define the etale hypercover predicate to mean: every $U_n$ is an algebraic space and its augmentation to $X$ is representable etale; in each degree the proper-face diagram [def-sfb-proper-face-diagram] has a limiting cone in the slice of fppf sheaves, and the canonical map from $U_n$ to its vertex is representable surjective etale. The canonical map composes with each projection to the corresponding simplicial operator. The empty matching boundary in degree zero gives $X$.
